attestations.note: The page heads him «(; - 356)» and gives one sentence: subdeacon in the church of the Alexandrians, champion of the dogmas of the First Council of Nicaea, greatly honoured by Athanasius the Great, martyred by the Arian heretics and by the heretical bishop George in the year 356. It prints no hymn. The corpus has no `types` slug for a subdeacon, so the office is said in the life.
